visualCharacteristics: rc6: Light grey (#f6f7fb) band continuing the intro; 3 white cards, each with a photo, client logo, client name, short description and "Read more" link to a client story detail page. White cards with photo on top, client logo, name, short text and arrow Read more link.

contentPattern.authoring: One row per card: cell 1 photo; cell 2 logo picture (optional, first paragraph), client name heading, description, link as last paragraph. Text option: one cell per row (heading, paragraph, optional link as last paragraph). White rounded cards in a scroll-snap row with prev/next buttons while the row overflows.

cells: H5 title, paragraph, optional CTA link

usage.description: Grid of client story cards: photo, client logo, name, description and Read more link.

reuseGuidance: Use for client stories / case studies that link to detail pages.
